podcast.body: In 2007, Timbaland scored a number one hit under his own name as the lead singer and rapper with "Give It To Me," just weeks after producing Justin Timberlake's "What Goes Around Comes Around." The song, featuring guest vocals by Justin Timberlake and Nelly Furtado, was a direct "beef track against Tim's former collaborator Scott Storch."
